body:
Add the horizontal component of the previously vertical-only EDMFX environment SGS diffusive flux. 

Adds `edmfx_sgs_horizontal_diffusive_flux` option (default `false`) for high-res configs (e.g., the gray-zone to LES regime) where the horizontal grid spacing is comparable to or smaller than the environment mixing length.

Water and enthalpy follow the approach in #4753. Water diffuses as a single substance `q_tot_eff = q_tot - q_rai - q_sno`. Enthalpy flux on the form `ρ K_{h,h} (∇ₕs_d + (h_eff + Φ) ∇ₕq_tot_eff)`  (`h_eff` the mass-weighted specific enthalpy of the suspended water). 

The momentum tendency is the horizontal divergence of `τ = -2 K_{u,h} S` calculated using the full strain rate
- applied to u,v,w and with TKE shear production from horizontal gradients. 

Note that the stress and the production are not energetically consistent with each other since the work done by the stress includes cross terms such as `S₁₃ ∂ₓw` that the production `2 ρ K_{u,h} |S_h|²` does not.

Anisotropy enters only through the mixing-length grid-scale limiter.
- added `grid_scale` kwarg to `ᶜmixing_length`, which defaults to the resolvability filter scale 
- the horizontal path passes the horizontal node scale, so that `l_h = min(l_phys, Δx_h)`. 
- diffusivities are cached once per explicit cache update (`ᶜK_u_h`/`ᶜK_h_h`)
- new diagnostics: `lmixh`, `edth`, and `evuh`.

For prognostic updrafts, the `edmfx_horizontal_diffusion` option (default `false`) applies the grid-mean horizontal specific tendencies uniformly to the updraft scalars, matching the uniform vertical treatment of `edmfx_vertical_diffusion` (#4720). 
- the `ρaⱼ` dry-mass counterpart of the water tendency is omitted, matching `edmfx_sgs_diffusive_flux_tendency!`, where it was removed in #4551.

Added docs describing the math in `docs/src/edmf_horizontal_diffusion.md`. 
Added a few unit tests too.
title: feat(edmfx): add horizontal component to the EDMFX SGS diffusive flux

body:
Completes the consolidation from #4699 for the EDMFX vertical path: the grid-mean SGS diffusive fluxes in `edmfx_sgs_diffusive_flux_tendency!` (total enthalpy via the dry static energy + water enthalpy decomposition, specific humidity, and grid-scale tracers with the α and interfacial-entrainment weighting folded into the flux coefficient) now use the shared `ᶠtotal_enthalpy_gradientᵥ` and `ᶜdiffusive_flux_divergenceᵥ`/`ᶜdiffdivᵥ` helpers. 

The TKE flux keeps its dedicated divergence operator, since its bottom boundary has a nonzero surface TKE flux, and the momentum stress keeps its strain-rate form.
title: refactor(diffusion): route EDMFX vertical diffusive fluxes through shared helpers
